description: Provides crop loans and short-term agricultural credit to farmers at 0% effective interest rate by offering state interest subvention on top of central crop loan schemes.
benefits: 100% interest subvention (0% effective interest rate) on timely repaid agricultural crop loans up to ₹3,00,000.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant cultivators, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) involved in agriculture in Arunachal Pradesh holding Kisan Credit Cards (KCC)
application_mode: Offline via Commercial Banks / Regional Rural Banks (APStRBN) / Deputy Commissioner (DC) Office

description: A front-ended credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at boosting farm mechanization, seed support, and post-harvest infrastructure for farmers across the state.
benefits: 45% Government Subsidy, 45% Bank Credit Loan, and only 10% Beneficiary Contribution for agricultural equipment and inputs.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs), SHGs, and Agri-cooperatives resident in Arunachal Pradesh
documents: Bank Account Passbook and Quotation for Implements
application_mode: Online via ANKY Portal / District Agriculture Officer (DAO) Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Plantation Scheme (Kiwi, Large Cardamom & Tea)
description: Promotes high-value horticulture crops like Kiwi, Large Cardamom, Orange, and Tea by providing subsidised quality planting material and establishment grants.
benefits: Up to 50% capital and input subsidy for orchard establishment, fencing, and drip irrigation installation.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning suitable land in mid and high-altitude zones of Arunachal Pradesh
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Circle Officer

description: A financial scheme designed to increase production of commercial fruits (Apple, Walnut, Kiwi, Orange) with structured bank loans and heavy state subsidies.
benefits: 45% State Subsidy + 45% Bank Loan + 10% Farmers' contribution for orchard setup and micro-irrigation equipment.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and registered horticulture cooperatives in Arunachal Pradesh
application_mode: Online / Offline via District Horticulture Office
